standard_prerequisites.use: The naive cotangent complex, its cohomology sheaves, and the characterisations of formal smoothness and formal unramifiedness by them; the combination is retained.

core_obligations: Show that formal etaleness forces both cohomology sheaves of the naive cotangent complex to vanish by combining the formally smooth and formally unramified cases.
Prove the converse from the vanishing of both sheaves.

proof_roadmap.step: Reduce to the formally smooth and formally unramified descriptions.
Combine them to obtain the vanishing under formal etaleness.
